html:
SMTO-KV-0008 — This conversation's scratch notes are full

GUID: 0af7b19c-0171-47f4-9789-cf5271f44c5d
Slug: kv-capacity-exceeded
Domain: KV · Subsystem: kv

What happened

  • The Agent tried to save another scratch note, but this Task already holds the most notes it can (256 notes or 512 KB in total). The new note wasn't saved, and existing notes are unchanged.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Send a follow-up asking the Agent to list its scratch notes and delete only the ones this work no longer needs. Removing notes that are no longer used frees room under this Task's limit.
  2. If the notes are all still needed, ask the Agent to shorten its longest notes instead of deleting them. Shorter notes use less of the 512 KB total, so the new note can fit.
  3. For a new, unrelated job, select New chat and start it in a fresh conversation. A new request in a new chat starts a new Task with its own empty set of scratch notes.

What success looks like

  • The Agent's next save appears as Saved task scratch data in the Run's activity.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't have the Agent delete notes the current work still depends on, and don't move these notes into a different conversation.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Agent KV rejected kv.put because the write would exceed the task scope's MAX_ENTRIES (256) or MAX_TOTAL_BYTES (512 KiB) quota after accounting for any value it replaces.

What this means

  • A prospective put would exceed the conversation's entry count or total encoded-byte quota after accounting for replacement of any existing value. KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.

Why this can happen

  • A prospective put would exceed the conversation's entry count or total encoded-byte quota after accounting for replacement of any existing value.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect entry count and total byte use, including whether this put replaces an existing key.

How to fix it

  • Quotas are defined in src/agent_runtime/kv/models.py and enforced in KVStore.put and MemoryKVStore.put per task scope (stored in the legacy conversation_id column). Use kv.list plus kv.delete, or shorter values, to free capacity in the same scope; do not raise the quotas, truncate values silently or write into another task's scope.
  • Remove or reduce stored values through the supported management operations to free capacity.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Authorized cleanup or reduction brings the intended put within both conversation quotas.

What not to do

  • Delete stored values only when authorized and no longer required; do not silently truncate data or write in another conversation.

Technical notes

  • KV checks apply only to the selected conversation. Rejected validation or compare-and-set does not authorize an unconditional replacement; diagnostics do not read or mutate additional stored values.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
